content.title: New Businesses December 2025
content.summary: In December 2025, several new businesses opened in Arvada, Colorado, including $1.35 A Scoop & Up Chinese Restaurant, At Ease Painting LLC, and HoneyMoon Bakery. Other notable additions are Behind The Cleats Collectibles, Complete Kaimana Kailani Holdings LLC, and Cre8tive Entertainment, among others. Each business has provided contact information for inquiries.
